title: Add onboard QA playbook and concise changelog fallback generator
author: Aisha Patel
ci_status: pass (initial smoke test flaky; rerun succeeded)
description: Motivation: onboarding throughput and release clarity for new model variants has been brittle due to manual QA steps and occasional failures in automated changelog drafting. This PR introduces an explicit onboard QA playbook (machine-readable and human-friendly) plus a concise changelog fallback generator that ensures a safe, audited release blurb when the full release-note synthesis pipeline fails. The goal is to reduce manual triage during rollouts, standardize minimal acceptance criteria, and guarantee a traceable changelog entry for compliance reviewers. What this changes: 1) onboard/playbooks/qa_playbook.md — an opinionated, versioned QA checklist with machine-readable probes (promptset sanity, sample-based accuracy checks, latency watermark, prefix-KV integrity test, embedding-size regression). The playbook is authored as markdown with frontmatter so it can be executed by the intake harness. 2) onboard/hooks/changelog_fallback_generator.py — lightweight generator that assembles a short, structured blurb from model metadata, recent perf snapshots, and a confidence tag. It runs as the final step in the onboard pipeline if the main auto-changelog job times out or returns low-confidence output. 3) onboard/signatures/curation_signature.py and onboard/signatures/README.md — a small artifact that cryptographically signs the curated profile and links it to the changelog blurb for auditability. 4) tests/onboard/test_playbook_runner.py and tests/onboard/test_changelog_fallback.py — unit+integration tests including an isolated smoke harness that previously flaked; adjusted timing and added retries to stabilize CI. 5) docs/onboarding/qa_playbook.md — high-level docs for solutions engineers and SREs with examples and escalation steps. Rollout plan: feature is behind a gate in the intake orchestrator; rollout will be enabled for 10% of new onboard jobs for two weeks then increased if no regressions. Backwards compatibility: the fallback only activates when the existing autodraft pipeline exits without a usable note; it never replaces curated release notes. Testing and CI: initial runs showed a flaky timing failure in the smoke probe; I added retry logic and a short backoff which made CI green. See linked Linear ENG-8913 for acceptance criteria and ENG-9087 for the changelog quality metric. Migration notes: no model metadata schema changes required; if teams want the signature artifact they must opt into the curation-signing workflow via a flag in onboard config. Files changed and tests added are intentionally small and isolated.

release_notes: Add a formal onboard QA playbook and a concise changelog fallback generator; new curation signature artifact for auditability; tests and docs included. Rollout gated and opt-in for signing. Improves onboarding reliability and ensures a minimal tracked release blurb when full autodraft fails.
perf_impact: none significant; introduces additional lightweight probes that run as part of onboarding only and optional signing overhead when enabled
notes_for_ops: Gate enabled via onboard.orchestrator.flags.qa_playbook_v1; ops should watch intake-job success rate and changelog-fallback:count metric. If fallback spikes, page the intake owners. See docs/onboarding/qa_playbook.md for remediation steps.
